rounds.defect: The long force trace visually reads like a torso-fired beam, weakening the intended limb-delivered non-custodial impulse.
rounds.correction: Keep the contact seam local: shorten authored K3-K5 force vectors and render contact-phase force from the seam/object face while preserving rear-root pin and foot-to-object contact geometry.

rounds.finding: Body-first approach and deep rear-root coil stay distinct from the static object; eligibility remains a visible gap; impact is a short local seam; K5 COM continues through the fixed rear root while the object only shears; K6 hard-separates contact, after which object lead and opposing body recoil split into independent clocks; overshoot/catch/rebound end displaced rather than reverse-interpolating.

noodle_queen.finding: The mechanism is compact and specific: a root-earned impulse, one brief non-custodial seam, obvious object lead after separation, and recoil debt paid at a displaced catch. The object is not a carried prop and the recovery is not an idle reset.
